## Pull Request Summary

### Description of Changes
A concise summary of what changes were made and why.

### Related Issue
Closes #(issue number)

---

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / Theme refinement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance / Memory optimization
- [ ] 🧪 Unit or integration tests

---

## Verification & Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug` compiles successfully with 0 errors.
- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes all unit tests.
- [ ] `./gradlew lint` passes with no new warnings or errors.
- [ ] Tested on a physical Android device (Device: `...`, OS: `...`).
- [ ] Added KDoc comments to any new public methods and classes.
- [ ] Followed the code style guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
